data.narrative:
Cosmic Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by James Emerick and Lewis Jones that has raised $4.5M to date. The valuation framework draws from a peer universe of 9 robotics companies—1 public (ticker: 277810.KQ) and 8 private firms including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

Stage-progression methodology is the applicable valuation approach here. Using total capital raised ($4.5M) as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for Seed-to-Series A advancement yields an implied valuation of $11.25M. This method is suitable given the company's clear stage positioning, though it relies on the assumption that capital deployed correlates reasonably with value created.

Peer-median analysis was not applicable. While 11 same-sector robotics companies exist in the comparison set, the narrow filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier) yielded insufficient datapoints—below the three-company minimum needed for robust median benchmarking. Relying on all-sector medians risked introducing uncontrolled heterogeneity.

The triangulated valuation range is $10M (low) to $13M (high), with a median of $11M. This narrow band reflects dependence on a single applicable method rather than convergence across multiple approaches. Key uncertainties include differentiation within the robotics sector, capital efficiency relative to peers, and early-stage execution risk. Additional comps or forward-looking metrics would strengthen conviction in this range.
